mapper.update: UPDATE pur_order_detail SET received_qty = received_qty + #{delta}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{orderDetailId} AND received_qty + #{delta} >= 0 AND deleted = 0
UPDATE sal_order_detail SET out_qty = out_qty + #{delta}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{orderDetailId} AND out_qty + #{delta} >= 0 AND deleted = 0

UPDATE fin_receivable SET settled_amount = settled_amount - #{amount}, status = IF(settled_amount - #{amount} <= 0, 'UNSETTLED', 'PARTIAL'), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{receivableId} AND settled_amount >= #{amount} AND deleted = 0

UPDATE fin_payable SET settled_amount = settled_amount - #{amount}, status = IF(settled_amount - #{amount} <= 0, 'UNSETTLED', 'PARTIAL'), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{payableId} AND settled_amount >= #{amount} AND deleted = 0
